## Overview

Studying the modern Information Systems Management MSc at De Montfort University explores emerging technologies through an AI-driven perspective, bridging the gap between technical expertise and strategic business leadership. The programme is designed to prepare professionals to lead digital transformation, govern AI ethically, and leverage systems and data analysis to drive business value.
